scope: Anywhere in view; judged by visible appearance only.

text.criterion: A knife or bladed tool is clearly visible, judged by its visible appearance only.
text.counter_examples: Pictures of knives, cutlery drawings, or long thin objects without a visible blade do not count.

hard_negatives: Long thin objects without a visible blade (rulers, pens)

status.note: Experimental preset, not validated: no accuracy claim. On the internal knife check every real knife was missed at gate 0.95.
